annotations.title: Swap: build the transactions to sign

description: Build a swap for your own wallet to sign and send, on Robinhood Chain, HyperEVM, Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum or Solana. Returns a firm quote (amount out, minimum, every fee) and the unsigned transactions in order. EVM chains: an exact-amount approval when needed, then the swap. Solana: one versioned transaction (base64) your wallet pays for and signs. Fivebar's 0.5% fee is paid inside the swap; Fivebar never sees your keys or holds your funds. Wallets on the US sanctions list are refused. xStocks are coming soon.

amount.description: How much of the sell token, in whole units, e.g. '100' or '0.25'

buy.description: Token to buy, same forms as sell

chain.description: Default robinhood (solana when given Solana tokens)

sell.description: Token to sell: ETH, WETH, USDG (Robinhood Chain), HYPE, WHYPE, USDT0 or USDC (HyperEVM), USDC or USDT (Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum), SOL, USDC, USDT or a mint (Solana), or a token address

taker.description: Your wallet address (0x..., or a Solana wallet): it signs and sends the transactions and receives the tokens
